name: Delaware

creditorClaims.text: Pre-death claims are barred unless presented within 8 months of the decedent's death, whether or not notice to creditors was given (12 Del. C. § 2102(a)); post-death claims within 6 months after they arise (§ 2102(b)).

earliestClose.text: The executor or administrator has 1 year from the date of letters to settle the estate and is not required to distribute before then (12 Del. C. § 2311); legacies are payable 1 year from first appointment if no time is set (§ 2312).

smallEstate.text: Distribution without letters by affidavit 30 days after death if the personal estate (excluding jointly owned property and property in § 1901(b),(c)) does not exceed $50,000, debts are paid, the spouse's allowance is satisfied and the decedent owned no Delaware real estate (12 Del. C. § 2306). Not indexed.

simplified.text: Small estate affidavit filed with the Register of Wills for personal estates up to $50,000 with no Delaware real estate (12 Del. C. § 2306).

filingFee.text: Register of Wills fees are set by the governing body of each county and posted at each office (12 Del. C. §§ 2510, 2511); the New Castle County fee list was not read.

personalRepFee.text: Commissions are allowed as provided by rule of the Court of Chancery and may be reduced for late accounts (12 Del. C. § 2305); no percentage schedule in the statute.

attorneyFee.text: Attorneys' fees are allowed as provided by rule of the Court of Chancery (12 Del. C. § 2305); no statutory schedule.
